articles.title: Venezuelan ‘dark fleet’ tanker evades US Coast Guard as Russia sends submarine to escort vessel: reports
articles.summary: Reports indicate a Venezuelan 'dark fleet' tanker successfully evaded the US Coast Guard. This incident was further complicated by Russia dispatching a submarine to escort the vessel. The situation highlights growing international maritime tensions and complex geopolitical maneuvering, involving multiple global powers in a sensitive high-seas operation, potentially challenging international maritime law and security protocols.

articles.title: ISRO to launch PSLV-C62 mission on January 12 from Sriharikota
articles.summary: ISRO is set to launch its PSLV-C62 mission on January 12 at 10:17 AM IST from Sriharikota's Satish Dhawan Space Centre. This mission highlights India's indigenous capabilities in space technology. For SSB aspirants, such launches demonstrate national scientific prowess, self-reliance, and contribution to global space exploration, underscoring India's growing stature in critical technological domains.
